rules.name: Rename Recommendation
similarity_exemplars: The error is due to the filename having a space. Rename the file to spaceinvaders.py
You should change the name of the file to avoid errors with spaces.
Go ahead and modify the filename to remove the space char.

rules.name: Support Mode Refocus
similarity_exemplars: Open your IDE and navigate to the project directory.
Right-click on the file and select Open or Edit.
Paste the new code block into the editor and save by clicking File menu.
Use a text editor like Notepad++, Sublime Text, or Atom.
